# TPC-DS Q84 — Customer Income Band Lookup

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Customer lookup filtered by city and income band with store returns

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, COALESCE(c_last_name, '') || ', ' || COALESCE(c_first_name, '') AS customername FROM customer, customer_address, customer_demographics, household_demographics, income_band, store_returns WHERE ca_city = 'Hopewell' AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ib_lower_bound >= 32287 AND ib_upper_bound <= 32287 + 50000 AND ib_income_band_sk = hd_income_band_sk AND cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk AND hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk AND sr_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q84_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q84: Customer lookup filtered by city and income band (Polars)."""
    params = get_parameters(84)
    city = params.get("city", "Edgewood")
    income_min = params.get("income_min", 38128)
    income_max = params.get("income_max", income_min + 50000)

    # Get tables
    customer, customer_address, customer_demographics, household_demographics, income_band, store_returns = _tables(
        ctx,
        "customer",
        "customer_address",
        "customer_demographics",
        "household_demographics",
        "income_band",
        "store_returns",
    )

    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    # Filter by city
    ca_filtered = customer_address.filter(col("ca_city") == lit(city))

    # Filter income band
    ib_filtered = income_band.filter(
        (col("ib_lower_bound") >= lit(income_min)) & (col("ib_upper_bound") <= lit(income_max))
    )

    # Join tables
    result = (
        customer.join(ca_filtered, left_on="c_current_addr_sk", right_on="ca_address_sk")
        .join(customer_demographics, left_on="c_current_cdemo_sk", right_on="cd_demo_sk")
        .join(household_demographics, left_on="c_current_hdemo_sk", right_on="hd_demo_sk")
        .join(ib_filtered, left_on="hd_income_band_sk", right_on="ib_income_band_sk")
        .join(store_returns, left_on="c_current_cdemo_sk", right_on="sr_cdemo_sk", how="semi")
    )

    # Select and format output
    return (
        result.with_columns(
            (ctx.coalesce(col("c_last_name"), lit("")) + lit(", ") + ctx.coalesce(col("c_first_name"), lit(""))).alias(
                "customername"
            )
        )
        .select(
            [
                col("c_customer_id").alias("customer_id"),
                "customername",
            ]
        )
        .sort("customer_id")
        .head(100)
    )
```
